claim_scores.rationale: Patches `dspy.settings` with `send_stream` set, `caller_predict = None`, and calls `_get_stream_completion_fn(request, {}, sync=False, headers=custom_headers)`.
Mocks `litellm.acompletion` with an async generator, awaits `stream_fn()`, and inspects `acompletion_mock.call_args.kwargs`.
Asserts `call['headers']['Authorization']` matches the supplied bearer token.
Mocks `litellm.stream_chunk_builder` to return `{'built': True}` and asserts the awaited result equals that object.
